summary: ArgoCDTools is a working repo: a standard-library Python 3 `presync` package run as `python3 -m presync <repo> <revision> <stage> <namespace>` that requires GIT_USERNAME/GITHUB_TOKEN by name, clones the deploy repo at exactly the SHA it was handed through an inline credential helper, brings up terraform-backend-git (or attaches to one via PRESYNC_TF_BACKEND) and resolves argocd/<repo>/<stage>/terraform.tfstate into the three -backend-config flags init takes. Gate is .kubecoder/project.yaml with jenkins: IaC/ArgoCDTools — ruff check/format plus 22 unittest cases, green from the repo root; also exercised live from this pod against the environment's own backend on 6061, both the success and the failure paths.
